entries.title: Psalms 99:1
segments: ¶Jehovah reigneth: let the peoples tremble. He sitteth [between the] cherubim: let the earth be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 99:2
segments: Jehovah is great in Zion, and he is high above all the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 99:3
segments: They shall praise thy great and terrible name, --it is holy! --

entries.title: Psalms 99:4
segments: And the strength of the king that loveth justice. *Thou* hast established equity: it is thou that executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 99:5
segments: Exalt Jehovah our God, and worship at his footstool. He is holy!

entries.title: Psalms 99:6
segments: ¶Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name: they called unto Jehovah, and *he* answered them.

entries.title: Psalms 99:7
segments: He spoke unto them in the pillar of cloud: they kept his testimonies, and the statute that he gave them.

entries.title: Psalms 99:8
segments: Jehovah, our God, *thou* answeredst them: a forgiving *God wast thou unto them, though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.

entries.title: Psalms 99:9
segments: Exalt Jehovah our God, and worship at the hill of his holiness; for holy is Jehovah our God.
